 Although President Donald Trump is making campaign appearances in several states in an effort to keep Republicans in control of Congress, there has been no visit announced for the Hoosier State.
 Nationally, the Democratic Party is hoping to break the GOP majorities in both the House and Senate to in essence make Trump’s final two years in office meaningless.
